shared_elements: animal figures in profile carved on stone
quadruped with elongated body and visible legs
small circular depressions or discs (cupules / bosses)
figures stacked in roughly horizontal tiers
justification: Both surfaces carry profile animals stacked in loose horizontal tiers, accompanied by small round depressions and a prominent arcing/crescent form, which is the most specific correspondence. However, A is a smoothly modelled bas-relief on a dressed rectangular pillar with clearly volumetric, framed registers, whereas B is a coarsely pecked outline drawing on an irregular natural rock face with no framing or modelling, so the manner of execution and the overall format differ fundamentally.
